definitions.explanation: A list at the beginning of a book or document showing the chapters, sections, or topics and their page numbers.

examples.japanese: {目次|もくじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: To look at the table of contents.

examples.japanese: {目次|もくじ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧3⟦ページ→ページ：02961_peeji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The table of contents is on page 3.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{詳|くわ}しい→詳しい：02483_kuwashii⟧{目次|もくじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ついている→付く：01960_tsuku⟧。
examples.english: This book has a detailed table of contents.

examples.japanese: {目次|もくじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧、⟦{読|よ}みたい→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦{章|しょう}→章：03768_shou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}した→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: I looked at the table of contents and found the chapter I wanted to read.

examples.japanese: ⟦レポート→レポート：01543_repooto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦まず→まず：00796_mazu⟧{目次|もくじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}って→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦{全体|ぜんたい}→全体：03314_zentai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{構成|こうせい}→構成：02729_kousei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考|かんが}えた→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧。
examples.english: Before writing the report, I first created a table of contents to think about the overall structure.

notes:
{目次|もくじ} lists the contents and organization of a book, document, or publication.

Related terms:
- {索引|さくいん} (index - alphabetical list at the end)
- {章|しょう} (chapter)
- {節|せつ} (section)

Usage:
- {目次|もくじ}を{見|み}る (to look at the table of contents)
- {目次|もくじ}から{選|えら}ぶ (to choose from the table of contents)

Digital context:
In digital documents and websites, {目次|もくじ} may be interactive, with clickable links to each section.
